hooks.command: cd /e/Tomes-Cloud && ./gradlew build -q 2>&1 | tee -a /e/LOGS/tomes-cloud/build/build.log && cd /e/Test-Automize && pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tee -a /e/LOGS/tomes-cloud/test/test.log

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE 'rm\s+-[rRfF]*r|rm\s+--recursive|git\s+push\s+(--force|-f\b)|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-[fdxX]+|git\s+checkout\s+--\s*\.|DROP\s+TABLE|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|rmdir\s+/[sS]|rd\s+/[sS]|del\s+/[fFsS]'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 1; fi
